column1: GATE 2027 CSE — Exhaustive High-Frequency Topic & PYQ Trap Master Checklist (All 11 Subjects)
Every sub-topic ranked by historical GATE appearance frequency (2015–2025), typical mark yield, recurring IIT question archetypes, and scheduled days in Sheet 2.

column6: Recurring GATE Question Archetype & Common Exam Trap
Tracing output of `*(a+i)+j`, array of pointers, pointer aliasing, and string literal modification/length
Counting total function calls or printed value when `static` variable persists across recursive stack frames
C pointer manipulation on singly/doubly list (detecting whether code reverses/deletes node), infix-to-postfix stack max size
Reconstructing tree from Pre+In or Post+In traversal, min/max nodes in AVL tree of height h, BST successor/predecessor
`O(n)` Build-Heap swaps, k-th smallest in min-heap, Linear/Quadratic probing insertion sequence & collision count
Ordering tricky functions (`n^log n`, `(log n)!`, `2^(√log n)`), solving recurrences via Master Theorem & substitution
QuickSort worst/best pivot comparisons, MergeSort inversion count, stability & in-place properties of sorting algorithms
Huffman average bits per char, Prim's/Kruskal's distinct MST count when edge weights repeat, Greedy choice counterexamples
Filling DP table for LCS or Matrix Chain Multiplication, time complexity of pseudo-polynomial 0/1 Knapsack
DFS tree/back/cross edge conditions, Topological sort count, Dijkstra failure on negative edges, Bellman-Ford iterations
Finding exact minimum number of states in DFA for divisibility/modulo or substring patterns using Myhill-Nerode
Equivalence of two complex regular expressions, identifying non-regular language via Pumping Lemma contrapositive
Matching CFG to exact set-builder language, distinguishing DCFL (`wcw^R`, `a^n b^n`) from non-deterministic CFL (`ww^R`)
Multi-select questions testing closure of Regular, DCFL, CFL, Recursive, and RE under Union, Intersection, Complement, Homomorphism

column2: Turing Machines, Halting, Reductions & Rice's Theorem
column6: Decidability of emptiness/finiteness/equivalence/ambiguity; applying Rice's Theorem to non-trivial semantic properties of RE
Counting exact number of tokens read by a C lexical analyzer using Maximal Munch rule
Computing `FIRST` and `FOLLOW` sets with nullable non-terminals, checking if grammar is `LL(1)` after left-factoring
Counting canonical `LR(0)` states, identifying Shift-Reduce vs Reduce-Reduce conflicts across SLR/LALR/CLR hierarchy
Tracing bottom-up or top-down parse tree evaluation to compute the exact numeric value printed at the root
Counting leaders/basic blocks, minimum registers needed via Liveness Analysis `IN/OUT` sets & SSA variable renaming
Calculating link utilization `1/(1+2a)`, minimum sequence number bits (`N+1` vs `2N`), and throughput with packet drops
Minimum frame size `L = 2 * Tp * B` in CSMA/CD, Binary Exponential Backoff contention window probability

column2: IPv4 Subnetting, VLSM, CIDR & LPM Routing
column6: Longest Prefix Match forwarding table lookup, CIDR route aggregation, and usable host/broadcast calculation
Calculating fragment offset (multiples of 8 bytes) & MF flag across multi-MTU links; Count-to-Infinity in Distance Vector
Tracking `cwnd` and `ssthresh` across Slow Start, Congestion Avoidance, 3-Dup-ACKs & Timeout; Sequence wrap-around time

column2: Token Bucket, DNS, HTTP, SMTP & RSA
column6: Token bucket max burst time, HTTP persistent/non-persistent RTT count, DNS iterative/recursive queries & RSA keys
Counting child processes created by `fork()` loops/logical AND/OR; SRTF & Round Robin turnaround/waiting time
Tracing semaphore `P(S)` and `V(S)` across concurrent processes to check mutual exclusion, deadlock, or max processes in CS
Finding minimum resources to guarantee deadlock-free execution (`R >= P*(N-1) + 1`) and safe sequences in Banker's
Calculating page table size, multi-level page walk memory accesses, TLB + Page Fault Effective Memory Access Time
Counting page faults for a reference string under LRU/FIFO/Optimal; Unix Inode max file size with single/double/triple indirect blocks
Minimum tables to represent an ER diagram; translating Relational Algebra division `R ÷ S` and TRC quantifiers
Predicting exact number of rows returned by nested SQL queries with `NOT EXISTS`, `GROUP BY`, `HAVING`, and `NULL` values
Finding all candidate keys from FD set, identifying highest normal form (3NF vs BCNF), and checking lossless join
Constructing precedence graph to test conflict serializability; checking view serializability, recoverability & 2PL
Calculating order `p` of internal and leaf nodes given block size, key size, record pointer & block pointer sizes
Expanding instruction opcodes (2-address vs 1-address vs 0-address) and computing effective address in indexed/PC-relative modes
Counting stall cycles due to RAW data hazards (with and without operand forwarding) and branch penalty; computing CPI & speedup
Calculating Tag, Set Index, and Byte Offset bits, Tag Directory size, and L1/L2 Write-Through vs Write-Back EMAT
DMA cycle-stealing CPU slowdown percentage; converting 32-bit IEEE 754 hex pattern to decimal value
Counting Prime Implicants (PI) and Essential Prime Implicants (EPI) in 4-variable K-Map with Don't Cares
Finding Boolean expression implemented by cascaded `4:1` or `2:1` Multiplexers and active-low Decoders
Finding modulus `Mod-N` of feedback counter, output frequency division, and max clock frequency from flip-flop setup/propagation delay
Translating English sentences into nested quantifiers `∀x∃y`, finding logical equivalence & valid inference rules
Counting equivalence/partial-order relations, Hasse diagram LUB/GLB, and subgroup orders via Lagrange's Theorem
Coefficient extraction in generating functions, Inclusion-Exclusion, Derangements & Pigeonhole minimum guarantees
Euler's planar formula `v - e + f = 2`, Chromatic number, Havel-Hakimi degree sequence, and vertex/edge connectivity
Using Trace = sum of eigenvalues and Det = product of eigenvalues; rank-nullity & system consistency conditions (`rank(A) = rank(A|b)`)
Bayes' theorem posterior probability, Expectation of indicator random variables, Poisson/Exponential probability numericals
L'Hospital limits, local maxima/minima via 2nd derivative & Hessian, and definite integral properties
Ratios, Time/Work, Permutations/Probability, Geometry/Mensuration, Syllogisms, Data Interpretation charts
Paper folding/cutting symmetry, 2D/3D shape rotations, Sentence completion, Critical reasoning inference
